title: First Techno (Kraftwerk 1970)
summary: The earliest existing concert video of Kraftwerk, from a 1970 performance shortly after the band formed. It shows the band in its original setup and the audience's reactions.
why: Used in techno-history threads as evidence of Kraftwerk's role in the genre's origins and as an example of original work.

quote.text: Still one of my favourite clips on youtube: the very first video recording of Kraftwerk live, from 1970!
